newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shun Tak surges on earnings hope.
newsitem.headline: Shun Tak surges on earnings hope.

text.p: Shares of Shun Tak Holdings Ltd surged on Wednesday on demand by investment funds on hopes of stronger earnings, brokers said.

"People are hoping for stronger earnings on the potential profitability of a joint venture residential development," said a dealing director at a regional brokerage. "There is also less fear of a possible cash call and the company will have lower cost of financing after it obtained a credit facility."
Shun Tak shares rose HK$0.60 or 13.19 percent to an intraday high of HK$5.15 per share in late trade before steadying at HK$5.05 on volume of HK$16.35 million shares.

The luxury residential development Belcher Garden, which is due to start presales in 1998, is a development 51 percent owned by Shun Tak, 29 percent by Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd, 10 percent by New World Development Co Ltd, and 10 percent by Liu Chong Hing Investment Ltd.
Arranger BNP Hong Kong had said on Tuesday the three-year revolving credit facility Shun Tak Finance has been increased to HK$1.8 billion from HK$1.0 billion because of oversubscription.
